body.headline: A shared place to choose the next useful step
body.subheadline: Teams can review the outcome, scope and evidence before committing to work.
body.customer: Small teams coordinating a shared project.
body.problem: The announcement, work and evidence are scattered across separate conversations.
body.solution: A project connects the proposed announcement to a small, reviewable evidence bundle.

inScope.statement: Review a project's press release and evidence in Planning.

outOfScope.statement: Automatically approving or publishing a release.
outOfScope.reason: The team reviews and decides separately.

openQuestions: Which acceptance scenario should the team verify first?

document.title: Shared planning — evidence bundle
document.body:
## Evidence inventory

This synthetic example demonstrates a small press release and evidence review page. In an operational organization, this document and the structured release are read from that organization's Wiki.

## Evidence gaps

No real customer test, external action or release approval is recorded.

## Next review

Choose an acceptance scenario and attach its observed result.
